items.title: The Kraft Heinz Company (KHC)’s Dividend Looks Safe. The Bigger Question Is Growth
items.summary: The Kraft Heinz Company (NASDAQ:KHC) keeping its quarterly dividend at $0.40 per share was not unexpected. Still, the fact that the payout has not increased in seven years is something income investors cannot easily overlook.
